nodes.label: NUMA-Aware Memory Affinity Allocation Engine
nodes.description: Hardware-aligned memory allocation engine pinning graph partition adjacency buffers directly to CPU socket NUMA nodes to minimize inter-socket bus latency during parallel traversals.

nodes.label: Roaring Bitmap Compressed Adjacency Index
nodes.description: High-performance hybrid bitmap indexing structure optimizing set intersection and union operations over sparse and dense integer arrays for adjacency list evaluation.

nodes.label: Deterministic Knowledge Triple Extraction Pipeline
nodes.description: Rule-guided syntactic and dependency parser converting unstructured text chunks into normalized subject-predicate-object triples tied to stable semantic entity identifiers.

nodes.label: Qutrub Rule-Based Arabic Verb & Noun Stemmer
nodes.description: Morphological analysis engine implementing classical Arabic grammar rules to extract root lemmas for accurate bilingual cross-lingual entity resolution.

nodes.label: ISO/IEC 27001 Zero-Trust Information Security Standard
nodes.description: International standard specifying strict security controls for information security management systems operating in air-gapped, zero-telemetry sovereign runtime environments.
